war.span_state_rule: ongoing if war.ongoing===true; else closed if war.end!=null; else end_unknown. Never infer ongoing from note text.

closed.bar: solid, start->end, fill colour @0.55, 6px tall, 1px #0f1b24 edge, end caps = icon at start, 2px tick at end

ongoing.bar: start->present edge (2026), fill colour gradient @0.55->@0.15 over last 15% of track, chevron arrow at right edge (left in RTL)

end_unknown.bar: NONE. Draw start marker (icon disc) + 12px dashed stub (dash 2 2, colour @0.7) ending in a small open circle; tooltip 'end not recorded'
end_unknown.rule: never imply a span or the present

battle_point.war_tint: exact: disc fill = war colour; approximate: ring = war colour; region: halo = war colour; reported: unchanged grey #b9a8a2
battle_point.badge: war icon 10px at top-right of marker at zoom>=8

hover.sync: hovering bar highlights its battles on map and vice versa

war.light_bg_rule: On web.css pages (bg #fbf8f2) all war colours are <3:1; draw every swatch/bar with a 1.5px #2b1d0e outline and the icon in #2b1d0e.

legend_entry.layout: 14px swatch (colour + hull dash as border) | 14px icon | name | dates as in data | state suffix
legend_entry.filter: only wars with era_ids overlapping the current era, plus 'all wars' toggle

peace_agreement_milestone.glyph: open diamond (rotated square), no fill; 10/12/14px by zoom
peace_agreement_milestone.placement: on the war span at the agreement date, centred on the bar
peace_agreement_milestone.contrast_note: The light stroke carries the mark on #0f1b24 and the topo tones (>=3.94:1). On light pages the #2b1d0e casing is the visible edge (>=14.8:1) and the light stroke is the inner line.
peace_agreement_milestone.label: "<agreement name> <year>" + cite (source_id and pages from the event row), e.g. "Juba Peace Agreement 2020 · UNSC2559 p.2"; Arabic from the event ar field with its VERIFY chip when tagged
rules: A milestone never closes, shortens or ends a war span; the end comes only from the war record.
Start-only wars keep "end date unknown" even with a milestone on them.
No milestone without a landed event row that has a registered cite; the Map Designer adds no events.
Shape (open diamond) distinguishes it from battle discs/rings and event pins (CVD-safe).
peace_agreement_milestone.data_source: db/era_events_post1956.json (Analyst) merged into legend context.key_events by event_id

milestones.name_en: Sudan–South Sudan Cooperation Agreements, Addis Ababa, 27 Sep 2012 (UNSC2075 p.1)

legend_label.rule: every war's legend entry and war button shows the war's name_en as a text label; wars are never told apart by colour alone

dash_disambiguation.decision: IM 2026-10-25: option (a) six-dash set + (c) lightness-only adjustment for 4 residual pairs
dash_disambiguation.rule: no two wars share a dash if min dE00 (normal, deutan, protan, tritan; Machado 2009) < 10
dash_disambiguation.colour_method: CIELAB LCh: hue and chroma kept, L only; >=3:1 vs #0f1b24; halo unchanged

battle.colourblind: Precision is shown by shape (solid disc, ring, halo, dashed ring), never by colour alone. Battles (vermillion #f08c6c) and events (sky #8cc8f0) stay apart under deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia thanks to the glyph difference (swords vs pin) and the luminance contrast against #0f1b24. In the war palette, wars that sit close in hue under CVD are told apart by a different hull stroke dash.

event_pin.anchor: bottom tip (12,20.5); pin drawn at 0.82 scale about (12,12) inside the 24x24 box
event_pin.coexistence: Battle markers are centred on the point and pins are tip-anchored. When a battle and an event share a place_id or sit within 12 px, offset the pin +10 px east (west in RTL), draw a 1 px #9fb3c2 leader line, and keep the battle on top. Three or more markers within 24 px collapse into a count badge (#14232f fill, #e0a63e text) that expands on click.

timeline_ticks.range_events: bar from start to end at 0.4 opacity, ticks at the ends
timeline_ticks.hover: tick to #ffd54a and show a tooltip
timeline_ticks.selected: tick to #ffd54a, w+1, synced with the map marker

z_order_bottom_to_top: reported clashes (same layer as battles, drawn under confirmed ones)

war_footprint.trigger: select a war chip, or select a battle and choose 'show war'
war_footprint.palette_note: 20 slots covering every war_id in db/wars.json plus the Analyst's post-1956 ids. Each slot differs from the others in hue, dash pattern or both.

treatment.battles_in_war: opacity 1, outline 2 px war colour; other battles dim to 0.25, cities stay
treatment.hull: convex hull of the war's battle points (buffer 15 km; a single point gets a 25 km circle; region-precision points use their polygon), fill war colour @0.08, stroke war colour 1.5 px with hull_dash; RTL needs no change
treatment.sequence: optional thin 1 px war-colour polyline joining battles in date order, with small arrowheads, off by default
treatment.label: war name at the hull centroid, EN/AR [VERIFY], halo #0f1b24
treatment.legend_entry: swatch of hull + war name + date span + battle count
treatment.multi_war: up to 3 wars at once, each with its own hull dash; beyond that, show only the last selected

war_footprint.palette_update: 2026-10-25: 15 colours lightened for >=3:1 vs overlapping era fills (IM approved)

legend_label.rule: every war's legend entry and war button shows the war's name_en as a text label; wars are never told apart by colour alone

dash_disambiguation.decision: IM 2026-10-25: option (a) six-dash set + (c) lightness-only adjustment for 4 residual pairs
dash_disambiguation.rule: no two wars share a dash if min dE00 (normal, deutan, protan, tritan; Machado 2009) < 10
dash_disambiguation.colour_method: CIELAB LCh: hue and chroma kept, L only; >=3:1 vs #0f1b24; halo unchanged

war_footprint.war_halo_ref: db/legends/legend_spec.json war_halo (#0b141b 2px + #ffffff 0.5px edge under every war hull stroke); battle halo #e8e2d0 unchanged

text.en: {short_name} {year}, with an alt name in brackets where one is common, e.g. 'Karari (Omdurman) 1898', 'Shaykan 1883', 'Kerma 1500 BCE'
text.bce: ids use a double hyphen (kerma--1500); labels show '1500 BCE' / '١٥٠٠ ق.م' [VERIFY]

label.font: map.css UI font, 12px at z<=6, 13px at z7-9, 14px at z>=10; weight 600 for decisive, 400 otherwise
label.placement: preferred to the right of the marker (left in RTL), then above, below, the opposite side; 4 px offset from the icon edge; never over the marker of another battle
priority: decisive: read from the decisive flag in data/battles.json (no hard-coded list)
label.collision: greedy by priority with 3 px padding; a lower-priority label that collides is hidden (marker stays, label on hover). City labels outrank non-decisive battle labels but not decisive ones. At z<=5 only decisive labels show.
label.rtl: in AR mode, mirror placement and keep the year as Arabic-Indic numerals [VERIFY]; parentheses mirror automatically with dir=rtl

contested.applies_to: items with badge 'CONTESTED' (e.g. south-sudan-civil-war 2013 battles in db/battles_post1956.json)
contested.consistent_with: map.css .hm.cont .dot uses an amber #e0a63e 1.5px outline for contested points; the same amber is used here

marker.outer_ring: #e0a63e 1.5px, drawn 1.5px outside the base icon's edge

corner_badge.position: top-right (top-left in RTL), offset so it overlaps the icon edge by 25%

combine.approximate: ring is drawn outside the vermillion ring with a 1px gap
combine.region: badge on the glyph centre's top-right; the halo is unchanged; the area outline goes amber dashed 4 3
combine.reported: badge + ring; the ring keeps the dashes (3 2.2) in amber so both states read

states.selected: yellow #ffd54a selection outline drawn outside the amber ring

contested.timeline_tick: amber 3px diamond cap on the tick

legend.en: Contested: sources disagree on control or outcome
legend.ar: متنازع عليه: تختلف المصادر حول السيطرة أو النتيجة [VERIFY]

contested.colourblind: amber is backed by the diamond shape and the ring, so it is never colour alone

end_badge.applies_to: any war in db/wars.json with a non-empty end_badge (any value, e.g. VERIFY); the text comes from the value, there is no per-value styling

timeline_war_bar.end_segment: last 15% of the bar (min 12px) fades from opacity 1 to 0.35 and switches to dash 3 2 at the same weight

badge.position: just after the bar end (before it in RTL)
badge.raw_value: show the end_badge value as a small prefix tag when it isn't 'VERIFY', e.g. 'DISPUTED · end date unverified'

hover.tooltip: end_note (EN; in AR mode use end_note_ar if present, else the EN text marked [VERIFY])
hover.fallback: if end_note is empty, show only the badge text

war_footprint_label.badge: the same pill after the war name and date span (before in RTL); the date span renders as 'from – to?' with the end year at 0.6 opacity

end_badge.colourblind: the amber is backed by the dash change, the fade and the text badge

apx.note: Stand-in locations (EDITORIAL) and APPROXIMATE points are drawn dashed and faded; religion_language_present shares are all APPROXIMATE (country-level).
